title: Advertise Python 3.14 in the package classifiers
lead:
CI now tests 3.14 (S124) but `pyproject.toml` still stops at 3.13, so the published package
understates what it supports.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S124 added 3.14 to the CI and publish matrices, so the suite is enforced on 3.11 through
3.14. `pyproject.toml:13-21` still lists only `Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11`,
3.12 and 3.13. `requires-python = ">=3.11"` is correct and does not need changing, but the
classifiers are what PyPI renders on the project page, so a 1.0.0 release would ship
metadata claiming less than the project actually tests. It is a small fix, but it is only
correct to make once CI genuinely covers 3.14, which it now does.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `pyproject.toml` classifiers include `Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14`.
2. The classifier list matches the CI matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, with
   `requires-python` unchanged at `>=3.11`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Add the 3.14 classifier. While there, confirm the list agrees with the CI matrix and that
no stale version is advertised. Do not touch `requires-python`; 3.11 is still the floor.
Worth wiring as a dependency of S128 so the release does not go out with understated
metadata — settle that with the owner rather than editing S128 unasked.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Classifiers match the CI matrix; `slicer check` and the suite pass.
